push.title: W 4-3 vs FC Creamsters | You: 10.0 (best match performance)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 10.0. That's not a performance, that's a postcard from the top of the mountain.

DID WELL
+ 93% passing on 29 attempts, up from your usual 72%. You kept us calm by keeping the ball.
+ 5 shots at FC Creamsters's goal. You were hungry in front of goal, and I love a hungry striker.
+ 2 goals from 3 on target. That's how you punish a defense.
+ 4 key passes (up from your usual 2). Chance creation is generosity with a soccer ball.
+ A brace against FC Creamsters, your 2nd straight match scoring. Somebody check the net for scorch marks.

WORK ON
- 3 of 5 shots on target. Tiny tweak: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide. Biscuits if you nail it.

Fundamentals drill: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.

Last thing, PhogsToffees. Champions are just ordinary folks who kept showing up.

The team's lucky to have you. - Coach Lasso

weaknesses.detail: Tackles attempted: 1 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 2 or less)
weaknesses.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
weaknesses.coach: Need more bite without the ball. Defending is everybody's job.

weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

push.title: W 4-3 vs FC Creamsters | You: 9.3 (best match performance)
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 9.3. I'm officially out of superlatives, and I keep a lot of 'em in my pocket.

DID WELL
+ 34 passes, your busiest match yet. You found pockets of space like a cat finds sunbeams.
+ A brace against FC Creamsters, your 4th straight match scoring. You put it where Grandma keeps the good cookies: right on the top shelf.
+ 1 key pass. You're the reason the forwards have something to celebrate.
+ You and PhogsToffees speak the same football language.
+ 9.3 sets a new bar for you across 4 matches.

WORK ON
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Fix it like this: Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.
- 65% passing (22 of 34). Between you and me: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap. Trust me on that one.
- 3 shots off target cost 0.1. Think of it as a pebble in your boot. Shake it out.
- 3 goals conceded pulled 0.1 off. We'll get it back.

Rondo time: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.

Before you go, BellyTb1: Smile at the goalkeeper. It confuses 'em.

You made my night. Thank you. - Coach Lasso
